note: develop's own trigger fixture: queries that should invoke develop and near-miss negatives that should not. Used by the light trigger check and, at Publish, the full smoke test. Activation is proven by observing a skill tool call in a real run, never by a description read alone. This file is the worked example every skill carries; near misses are genuine neighbours, not obviously irrelevant queries. In tannergolden/intelligence the same cases also run from evals/skills/develop.json.
